normalization: PR metadata and checks/workflow rows are compact projections of GitHub API responses. All returned check-run/workflow-run identities and statuses are retained; PR bodies and unrelated response fields are omitted.
limits: Collection pagination uses per_page=100. Each returned collection has total_count equal to its first-page row count and less than 100, so each observed collection is complete in one page.

The non-atomic collection can evolve immediately after retrieval. The final metadata reread bounds head/base races; it does not freeze check execution or guarantee all future checks have been created.
Elapsed time exceeded the two-minute target by about five seconds at the final metadata responses; no subsequent remote calls were made.
Current-head status observations do not replace native source-equivalence evidence or the sealed 01:35 snapshot.
